rating_source: Google Maps live listing, confirmed via 2 separate live fetches (gmaps_detail.js and a custom Playwright extraction) on 2026-08-14: rating 5.0, review summary block explicitly states '10 reviews', all 10 individual reviews scraped were 5-star. Matches the rating given in the discovery brief (5.0); the discovery brief's '10' review count is also confirmed exactly (brief said 10, not the initially-uncertain earlier fetch that returned null before a second, deeper fetch located the review count).
own_site_check: gmaps_detail.js confirmed website: null (Maps panel shows 'Add website' button). WebSearch for 'Golden Rule Repair & Remodeling Lakeland website' and variants returned no matching own-domain result (only unrelated same-name businesses in other states/cities: Golden Rule Remodeling Inc in Salem OR, Golden Rule Handyman Springfield IL, Golden Rule Home Repair & Remodel LLC Phoenix AZ, Golden Rule Construction Group Auburndale FL -- all different, confirmed-different entities by address/phone). Tested candidate domains via curl: goldenrulerepair.com, goldenrulerepairremodeling.com, goldenrulerepairandremodeling.com, goldenruleconstructionfl.com, goldenrulerepairlakeland.com, goldenrulerepairllc.com, goldenrulehomerepairremodeling.com, ericbushhandyman.com, goldenrulehandymanlakeland.com, goldenrulerepairfl.com -- all failed to resolve (curl exit 56, no DNS/connection). goldenruleremodeling.com resolves but is a confirmed unrelated business (Golden Rule Remodeling & Design Inc, Salem, Oregon -- verified by page content). Checked BBB, Angi, HomeAdvisor: no listing found for this exact Lakeland business under any of those directories. Conclusion: has_own_site is false.
services_note: No booking platform and no published price list. Services below are derived from three real, verifiable sources: (1) Google review text (verbatim, see reviews below) describing specific completed jobs, (2) the Google Maps 'service mentions' aggregation (aria-label tags: 'home repairs, mentioned in 2 reviews', 'door frame, mentioned in 2 reviews', 'garage door, mentioned in 2 reviews'), and (3) the business's own uploaded Google Maps photos, which show real completed jobs: mobile home siding repair/paint, roof coating, fascia/gutter repair, a custom interior door with built-in mirror, a finished exterior entry door, a rebuilt double garage door, and a front porch pillar replacement (before/after pair) plus room-addition/carport framing. No prices shown anywhere; the site uses 'Call for a quote' throughout.

reviews.text: Eric Bush with Golden Rule Repair & Remodeling in Lakeland is a good handyman. He did some roof siding replacement that had rotted. When finished it looked brand new. I have referred my friends and family to Eric for all sorts of things. He will do a good job at a fair price.
reviews.author: Mr. Bill
reviews.trim_note: Trailing unrelated sentence 'Before and after pics attached.' removed; no other words changed or added.

reviews.text: Eric repaired an issue I had with a couple of walls. He removed old wallpaper and put in drywall. Eric knows what he's doing! I am very pleased with his work and would highly recommend him.
reviews.author: Joyce Preston

reviews.text: Eric Bush/Golden Rule Repair & Remodeling did a great job installing my side garage door. He was very professional & efficient. He was able to find a reasonably priced door & used the most cost efficient way to install the door & frame. I haven't had any problems with the door. I would recommend Mr. Bush for your home repair needs.
reviews.author: A. Herbert
reviews.trim_note: Middle sentence 'I haven't had any problems with the door.' removed from the on-site quote for length; no words changed.

reviews.text: 'Golden Rule, LLC' & Eric Bush (Lakeland, FL) did an excellent job in replacing our side garage door and frame! Eric's attention to detail, and his dedicated regard for quality workmanship & patience is displayed in his work.
reviews.author: David L Smith
reviews.note: Google truncated this review with '... More' in the scrape; not used on-site to avoid displaying an incomplete quote.

reviews.text: I'm very happy with the work done. Eric was very helpful in finding a cost efficient approach to new pillars for my front porch.
reviews.author: Jamey Cordery

reviews.text: Trustworthy and reliable handyman service in Lakeland, FL. Great work from a great guy.
reviews.author: Martin Restrepo

reviews.text: Eric has a heart of "gold" and really cares about his clients! I would highly recommend for your home repairs!
reviews.author: Dustin Whitney

palette_note: Warm gold/amber trade palette (accent-deep #a8791f, accent-mid #c99a45) on a warm ivory base, derived by hue-shifting the light template's token system toward a golden-ochre tone, distinct from Amani's mocha (#8a6f4d) and from other handyman builds' copper/navy palettes already in the repo. The gold accent doubles as a subtle nod to the business's own name ('Golden Rule') without using any religious language on the site itself. Dark-band (CTA/footer) uses a near-black warm brown (#241b0a/#180f02) with a light champagne-gold accent (#f0cf8a), consistent with the design system's token structure.
cta_channel: No booking platform, no verified email, no verified social media. Primary CTA is tel:+16154794111 throughout (nav, hero, services cards, CTA final, floating call button); secondary CTA is sms:+16154794111 ('Send a text').
